correctness.rationale: For full Δ5,5 of nonattacking rook placements, quotient by simultaneous S5 on row+column labels is modelled by orbits of strict face chains in barycentric subdivision. This action preserves face cardinalities, hence cannot reverse orientation within each barycentric simplex. Source construction yields quotient orbit-cell dimensions [35,199,429,384,120] and an exact 582-unit-pivot integer reduction with residual chain C3=Z→C2=Z multiplication by 5 and a C0=Z generator. Independently built all 1167 barycentric orbit chain cells and boundary maps (rather than trusting saved log), checked ∂²=0 and independent modular ranks: over F2/F3/F7/F101 ranks (34,165,264,120), over F5 (34,165,263,120); furthermore an independently ordered integral unit-pivot elimination performed 582 cancellations, leaving a single residual differential +5. Hence H0=Z, H2=Z/5, other H_i=0. Classical chessboard connectivity for ν=3 establishes π1(Δ5,5)=0, while Armstrong orbit π1=S5/N vanishes because each generating transposition fixes a diagonal-square vertex. The Hurewicz π2 generator admits the degree-five Moore map, which induces an integral homology isomorphism; simply connected homological Whitehead gives X≃M(Z/5,2). Mod-p ranks alone would not prove integral torsion or Moore homotopy; independent integer reduction and separate π1 argument establish those parts.
